reviews.x: These are horrible.  I used them with my diamond studs and can not get them off!  I am having to go into the jewelers and have the earring posts cut in order to get them out of my ears and now I will have to spend a great deal of money to have my diamonds reset.

reviews.t: I definitely would not recommend this product
reviews.x: I have been trying for three months to get these backs off my diamond earrings!  Tried all of the suggestions listed in the thread as well as trying vasoline and WD40!  I am at my wits end.  I do not want to damage my diamonds so cutting them off is not an option.  I am at my wits end.  I definitely would not recommend this product.

Recently decided to wear earrings again. I bought myself very nice diamond studs. And dug out some smaller studs for my second piercings. I have been in agony! I was just about to give up on wearing them until I found these backs. Immediately after I put them on the pain stopped. And as other reviewers have said the "droop" is gone! They are expensive but to be able to wear earrings pain free, no worries about losing pricey earrings and no more "droop" makes these priceless.
exactly what I needed. they keep my earring from drooping

I had to use pliers and brute force to remove the back in order to get it off my wife's ear. She had to hold her diamond earring steady with her fingernails or else I would have pulled the earring back through her ear. The situation was completely frustrating and ridiculous; she said she should have paid attention to the other reviews that warned this would happen. These things are IMPOSSIBLE TO REMOVE if your post has any grooves or ridges in it, as hers did.

Delivered quickly, these are terrific at keeping my studs firmly in place.  I use them on my screw back diamonds.  Bonus is the backs measure about 10mm, so they address the dreaded "earring droop".  However, I placed the second pair (comes with 2 sets) on my secondary piercing studs, which have a small indentation at the end of the posts. They are now stuck on!  So, a helpful product, but BEWARE.

Lost three out of 4 in less than 2 weeks. Not sure what everyone is reviewing, I bought these based on the negative reviews saying they had to be cut off, I need secure backs for my almost 2 year old, she doesn't pull, but they come off while sleeping and changing.

reviews.t: OK, but not more effective than less expensive options
reviews.x: I wanted to love them, but the center and outer area separated after just a few uses and the openings were too large for some of my earrings.  I didn't find them any more effective than the larger clear earring backs in terms of support of your earrings.  I am looking for something to help me avoid having a doctor put stitches in one of my earlobes that has been stretched out, but these are not the answer.

claims.text: Many reviewers report the backs are extremely difficult or impossible to remove, sometimes requiring cutting or professional help.
Several reviewers say the backs come off or fall off easily, causing lost earrings.
Reviewers frequently praise the backs for keeping earrings in place and preventing drooping.
Some reviewers report the backs work well and provide security for their earrings.
A few reviewers mention the back coming apart or damaging earrings.
